headline: Browns best Steelers on TNF to take lead in AFC North
summary: The Browns move to 3-1 while adding to Pittsburgh's historic five-year futility in Cleveland.

headline: Mason Graham left Thursday's game on crutches and wearing a knee brace
summary: One of the only negative developments for the Browns on Thursday night was the left knee injury that knocked defensive tackle Mason Graham out of the game.

headline: Steelers' McCarthy regrets angry exchange with Rodgers in loss
summary: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said he regretted directing a profanity toward quarterback Aaron Rodgers during a heated exchange that was caught on the broadcast of Thursday's 27-24 loss to the Browns.

headline: 2026 NFL trade deadline early look: Candidates to move, key teams, predictions
summary: Could the Cardinals listen on Marvin Harrison Jr. or Josh Sweat? Will the Bears or Raiders be active? Here's our way-too-early preview of the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

headline: Greg Rousseau's sacks, Josh Allen's rushing TDs are on record paces
summary: With multiple sacks and rushing TDs, Rousseau and Allen are on cusp of streaks no one else has done.

headline: Falcons and Saints renew their longstanding rivalry as each seek early season momentum
summary: — Long-time Saints defensive end Cameron Jordan can be counted on to echo the sentiments of many New Orleans fans whenever the rival Atlanta Falcons are next on the schedule.
